definitions.gloss: sudden development; rapid turn of events; dramatic twist
definitions.explanation: A situation that changes rapidly and unexpectedly. Used for events, stories, negotiations, or any situation that takes a sudden turn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急展開|きゅうてんかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The situation took a sudden turn.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最終回|さいしゅうかい}→最終回：26891_saishuukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{急展開|きゅうてんかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a dramatic twist in the final episode of the drama.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急展開|きゅうてんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せ→見せる：01988_miseru⟧、⟦{予想外|よそうがい}→予想外：03188_yosougai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{至|いた}った→至る：02009_itaru⟧。
examples.english: The negotiations took a sudden turn and led to an unexpected agreement.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (sudden) + ⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧ (development, unfolding). Describes situations that change rapidly and unexpectedly.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {急展開|きゅうてんかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to develop rapidly
- {急展開|きゅうてんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show a sudden development
- {急展開|きゅうてんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach a sudden turning point
- {急展開|きゅうてんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げる→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧: to undergo a rapid change

USAGE:
- News: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急展開|きゅうてんかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ (the case took a sudden turn)
- Stories/drama: plot twists and surprise revelations
- Business: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急展開|きゅうてんかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ (negotiations took a dramatic turn)

Frequently used in news headlines and story narration. Carries a nuance of surprise — the development was not anticipated.
